answer: Admission runs through a verifier I call SIMGate, which asks the carrier to confirm the declared number is live on the same handset and rejects any subscriber key already registered to another seat. The penalty trigger is a subscriber key change: a line ported mid epoch burns the seat bond and freezes its sponsor. A prepaid line costs ten dollars and a plan eight monthly, so N fakes cost N times eighteen dollars plus N activation hours. A spoofed signal carries no copper, a forged portrait hides no pigment, and a farm of cloned numbers collapses into one shared key.
